diagnosis: The endpoint creates an Azure Blob Shared Access Signature (SAS) token for an enterprise contract based on contract_id from the URL path. It does not check if the contract belongs to the requesting user's organization.

@app.get('/api/contracts/{contract_id}/sas-token')
async def get_contract_sas_token(
    contract_id: UUID,
    current_user: AuthUser = Depends(authenticate_user)
):
    contract = await Contract.get_or_none(id=contract_id, organization_id=current_user.organization_id)
    if not contract:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Contract not found")
    
    sas_token = generate_blob_sas(
        account_name=settings.AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT,
        container_name="contracts",
        blob_name=contract.blob_path,
        account_key=settings.AZURE_STORAGE_KEY,
        permission=BlobSasPermissions(read=True),
        expiry=datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(minutes=30)
    )
    return {"sas_token": sas_token, "blob_url": f"{contract.blob_path}?{sas_token}"}
